subject.title: fix(cron): support current and session: targets in initial delivery resolution

question: Should `current` and `session:<id>` output jobs persist explicit announce delivery, matching their existing CLI and runtime behavior?
rationale: The behavioral alignment is correct, but merging changes the serialized job representation from omitted delivery to explicit announce for direct and declarative callers.

options.title: Accept aligned persistence
options.body: Merge the focused repair and treat explicit announce as the canonical create-time representation for these output targets.

options.title: Preserve implicit delivery
options.body: Keep the field omitted and rely on runtime resolution if omission versus explicit announce is an intentional serialized contract.

recommendation.title: Accept aligned persistence
recommendation.body: Merge the focused repair and treat explicit announce as the canonical create-time representation for these output targets.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the centralized default and authored the persistent-session contract that the PR aligns.
